text:
How do you break up two blind guys fighting?
Yell, "My money's on the guy with the knife!"
gist: To break up two blind men fighting, you shout that you're betting on the one with the knife, so both freeze in fear.

text:
A group of Engineering professors were invited to fly in a plane.
Right after they were comfortably seated, they were informed the plane was built by their students.
All but one got off their seats and headed frantically to the exits in maniacal panic.
The one lone professor that stayed put, calmly in his seat, was asked: “Why did you stay put?”
“I have plenty of confidence in my students. Knowing them, I for a fact can assure you this piece of shit plane will never even start”
gist: Engineering professors flee a plane built by their students, except one who stays calm because he knows his students' plane will never even start.

characters.looks: old professor, tweed jacket, calm, arms folded
panicking academics, glasses, rushing to exits
flight attendant, uniform, puzzled

text:
Two blind pilots enter a plane.
They have sunglasses and white sticks. As the plane starts to move, the passengers are uncomfortable. The plane gains speed, but it stays on the ground. The remaining runway gets smaller and smaller, and the plane is rushing towards a fence.
The passengers start shrieking and suddenly the plane lifts, avoiding the fence at the last second. All the passengers calm down, thinking it was a bad joke.
In the pilot cabin, the co-pilot turns to the pilot and says : "You know what? One day they're going to scream too late, and we're all going to die."
gist: Two blind pilots take off only when passengers scream at the runway's end, and worry that one day the screaming will come too late.

characters.looks: pilot in dark sunglasses with white cane
co-pilot in dark sunglasses, white cane
terrified passengers screaming, gripping seats

text:
Vier Männer sitzen im Krankenhaus-Wartesaal, während ihre Frauen entbinden.
Die Krankenschwester kommt zum ersten: „Glückwunsch, Sie sind Vater von Zwillingen geworden!“
„Das passt ja“, sagt der Mann stolz. „Ich arbeite bei Zweirad Stadler!“
Wenig später sagt sie zum zweiten: „Gratulation, es sind Drillinge!“
„Was für ein Zufall“, meint dieser. „Ich arbeite bei 3M!“
Die Krankenschwester geht zum dritten Mann: „Wahnsinn, es sind Vierlinge!“
„Das gibt’s doch nicht“, sagt er. „Ich arbeite für Schalke 04!“
Der vierte Mann wird plötzlich kreidebleich, hält sich den Kopf und fängt an zu zittern. „Was ist denn mit Ihnen los?“, fragen ihn die anderen mitleidig.
„Ich arbeite bei 7-Eleven!“
gist: In a maternity waiting room each father's number of babies matches a number in his employer's name, and the last man panics because he works at 7-Eleven.

wordplay.explanation: Company names containing numbers (Zweirad = two-wheel, 3M, Schalke 04, 7-Eleven) predict twins, triplets, quadruplets and then seven babies.

characters.looks: cheerful nurse in scrubs with clipboard
proud man in cycling jacket
man in office shirt, amazed
man in blue-white football jersey
man in convenience store uniform, pale and trembling
